summary.en: Search and write notes in the Notes app
summary.zh: 搜尋、撰寫「備忘錄」裡的筆記

text.en: Not yet: no local server for Notes that ShellBot can recommend. The ones that exist are each kept by one person and cannot be limited to reading.
text.zh: 還不能接：還沒有 ShellBot 能推薦的「備忘錄」本機伺服器。現有的都只有一個人在維護，也沒辦法限制成只能讀。

next.en: ShellBot will add a way once there is one it can stand behind; nothing needs doing now.
next.zh: 等有 ShellBot 信得過的接法就會加上；現在不用做什麼。
